subject: Compliance packaging: modular residency billing and HSM license tradeoffs
messages:
From: Tariq Ali <tariq@medsurg.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@medsurg.io>, LegalOps <legal@medsurg.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask: residency + HSM costing breakdown

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. A couple of follow-ups from our side as we prep for procurement:

1) We need a clear comparison between (a) a regional data residency surcharge (per-GB/month) vs (b) an HSM-seat licensing model (one-time + annual maintenance) for our US and EU footprint.
2) For audit logs, please outline retention tiers and incremental cost — in particular 90-day vs 3-year retention for our clinical telemetry.
3) HIPAA: we need to understand whether the residency/HSM offering affects your BA agreement or if there are any additional obligations for us to sign.

Procurement is asking for an itemized SOW and any baseline concession you can offer for a 24-month committed volume. We’re trying to model year-1 Opex vs year-2 TCO.

Can you send a table + a recommended packaging approach?

Best,
Tariq
Tariq Ali
Head of IT Operations
Medsurg Health
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Tariq Ali <tariq@medsurg.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, LegalOps <legal@medsurg.io>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask: residency + HSM costing breakdown

Tariq —

Appreciate the clarity. I attached a short SOW (Medsurg_SOW_v2.pdf) and a pricing workbook (HSM_pricing_model.xlsx) that breaks out three packaging options:

Option A — Residency Surcharge (per GB/month) + KMS seats
  • Low upfront; predictable monthly Opex
  • Audit logs billed per GB ingested + retention tier multiplier
  • KMS seats for key management (recommended for dev/staging)

Option B — HSM license (one-time install + annual maintenance) + residency credit
  • Higher CapEx in year 1 for HSM appliance seats; lower per-token runtime fees
  • 12–36 month amortization scenarios in workbook
  • Includes on-prem SOW workstreams if you choose dedicated HSMs

Option C — Hybrid: regional HSM in EU + residency surcharge in US
  • Best if you need strong cryptographic separation for PHI in EU, but prefer lower OpEx in US

Concessions we can offer for a 24-month commit:
  • 12% blended credit against residency surcharge applied in year 1 (applies if you commit >= $X/month)
  • Option to amortize HSM licence across first 18 months for ARR/CapEx smoothing

Audit retention tiers (see audit-retention-options.csv):
  • 90 days: included in core plan up to 50GB/month
  • 1 year: +$0.02/GB/month over baseline
  • 3 years: +$0.06/GB/month over baseline + annual indexing fee

HIPAA and BA: Redwoods’ standard BA covers hosted + dedicated. If you deploy private HSM (on-prem), we add a short addendum that clarifies physical custody and responsibilities for HSM key rotates and backups. No new legal exposures beyond standard terms — LegalOps, happy to sync if you have specific clauses.

Next steps I propose:
  1) You pick preferred packaging (A/B/C).
  2) We produce a one-page commercial summary for Procurement with line-item totals and the 24-month blended concession applied.
  3) If HSM on-prem is selected, we’ll attach the SOW and set an implementation kickoff.

I’m happy to hop on a 30-minute call with Procurement + Legal later this week.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Initial ask: residency + HSM costing breakdown

Ben / Rishi — quick notes before I reply to Tariq with final numbers: 

Key negotiation points they will push on:
  - Want to avoid large CapEx in year 1; leaning toward monthly residency surcharge. We should keep an option to present amortized HSM cost but show favorable unit economics in year 2.
  - Expecting procurement concession tied to 24-month commit; I floated 10–15% in the call. I prefer 12% blended (keeps margin intact).
  - Audit logs: they will want 3-year retention for regulatory audits — we should be explicit about indexing cost and retrieval SLA.

Proposed internal stance:
  1) Offer 12% first-year blended credit on residency surcharge for 24-month commit, contingent on minimum committed spend of $250k over 24 months.
  2) Offer amortization of HSM license over 18 months if they choose Option B; invoice 50% upfront, remainder amortized monthly.
  3) For 3-year retention, add an annual index/search fee of $6,000 and retrieval SLA of 72 hours for archived logs.

Margin check: this preserves ~68% gross on run-rate for residency + HSM mix in our baseline model.

If you both sign off, I’ll send the commercial summary and attach the SOW + workbook.

—Steph
(Internal)
From: Tariq Ali <tariq@medsurg.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@medsurg.io>, LegalOps <legal@medsurg.io>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging: modular residency billing and HSM license tradeoffs

Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear options and the SOW. Procurement likes Option A as the baseline (residency surcharge + KMS seats) but we have two asks before we proceed to signature: 

1) Can you extend the first-year blended credit from 12% to 15% if we sign a two-year committed volume and include a 6-month ramp schedule (so our committed baseline is prorated for months 1–6)?
2) For the 3-year audit retention, would Redwood accept a soft cap on retrieval charges (e.g., no more than $2,500 per retrieval event) given our expectation of occasional audit pulls?

If you can accept 15% blended credit with the ramp, and the retrieval soft cap, Procurement will circulate a PO and we’ll loop Legal for the BA addendum. Also please confirm the invoice schedule if we pick the amortized HSM route — they asked for the exact monthly amortization line to plug into their ERP.

Appreciate it — looking to get this across the line this quarter.

Best,
Tariq
(attachments referenced in-thread: Medsurg_SOW_v2.pdf [application/pdf], HSM_pricing_model.xlsx [application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet], audit-retention-options.csv [text/csv])
